headline: The Saudi-Pakistan Joint Business Council, formed by both governments, launched a private equity fund on Monday with an initial size of multi-hundred million, three-fourths of which will go to Pakistan.

card.desc: Joint Business Council fund to boost trade and investment.

caption:
Pakistan and Saudi investors launch a new fund!
According to Business Recorder, the Saudi-Pakistan Joint Business Council, formed by both governments, launched a private equity fund on Monday. The fund will start at "multi-hundred million" and is expected to grow. Three-fourths of the money will go to Pakistan, and the rest to projects in Saudi Arabia.
